column1: # Libraries Bun (BUN_VERSION in scripts/build.sh) statically links into Resources/roar-mcp on macOS,
# at the commits bun-v<version> pins (scripts/build/deps/*.ts; in-tree ones at the bun tag or the WebKit commit).
# Not listed: libuv and sqlite (Windows / non-static only), ICU (macOS roar-mcp links the system libicucore).
# scripts/fetch-bun-licenses.sh downloads each file into licenses/bun-deps/<name>-<file>; gen-notices.sh
# prints them and check-notices.sh requires the marker line of each in the roar-mcp section.
